patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section featuring a background video with overlaid text content and call-to-action buttons.
Alternating light grey and white background colors are used for successive content sections to provide visual segmentation.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating strong hierarchy, contrasted with lighter weight sans-serif for body text and descriptions.
A deep navy/charcoal serves as the primary dark color for text and backgrounds, complemented by a vibrant teal as a consistent accent for interactive elements and calls to action.
The hero section's overlaid text and call-to-action elements slide upwards and fade out as the user scrolls down, revealing the content below.

The primary navigation bar is sticky, transitioning from a transparent background over the hero video to a solid white background with a subtle drop shadow once the user scrolls past the initial viewport.
Content sections below the hero are revealed with a subtle fade-in and upward slide animation as they enter the viewport.

technique_notes: The hero section is built with a full-bleed background video that loops continuously, with all textual and interactive elements positioned on top using absolute positioning.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using CSS keyframes, cause the hero's text and buttons to animate by translating upwards and reducing opacity as the user scrolls, creating a sense of content receding into the background.

The global navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that changes its visual properties (background color, shadow) based on the scroll position, transitioning from transparent to opaque after a certain scroll threshold.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and very small, uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) are consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and card elements, contributing to a modern and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: The layout maintains a balanced density overall, with a notably airy and spacious hero section, transitioning to a more structured and slightly denser grid for product listings and content sections.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its immersive, full-bleed video hero showcasing an electric boat, immediately establishing a high-end, modern, and sustainable brand identity. This visual storytelling, combined with the smooth scroll-triggered animations, sets it apart from typical marketplace designs by creating an engaging and premium first impression.
